# Vault

> Free bank and credit union intelligence built on public FDIC and NCUA data.
> Covers roughly 4,500 FDIC-insured banks and 4,900 NCUA-insured credit unions.
> No login, no paywall. Also available to AI agents as a hosted MCP server.

Vault answers questions about US depository institutions using primary
regulatory sources: FDIC BankFind, the FDIC Summary of Deposits, NCUA 5300
call reports, Census ACS, and CFPB HMDA. Every figure traces to a public
filing. Data is free to use and cite.

## What Vault can answer

- Financial condition of a specific bank or credit union: assets, deposits,
  net loans, equity, net income, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, capital
  ratio, noncurrent loans, employee counts. Eight quarters of history.
- Peer comparison against similarly sized institutions, by asset band rather
  than geography alone.
- Deposit market share and competitive rank by county, for any bank or any
  county, from the FDIC Summary of Deposits.
- County demographics from Census ACS: population, median household income,
  median family income (the basis for CRA low/moderate-income thresholds),
  median home value, owner-occupied housing, poverty rate, unemployment.
- Mortgage lending activity from CFPB HMDA: originations, denials, denial
  rate and dollar volume, by lender or by county.
- Newly chartered banks and credit unions, and merger and acquisition
  history including acquired-institution records.
- Bank leadership and buying-committee contacts.
- Industry-wide aggregates: charter counts, branch counts, deposit totals.

## Data sources and currency

- FDIC BankFind — quarterly call report financials and institution records.
- FDIC Summary of Deposits — annual branch-level deposits, as of each June 30.
- NCUA 5300 call reports — quarterly credit union financials.
- U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey, 5-year estimates.
- CFPB HMDA Data Browser — annual mortgage application outcomes.

Known coverage limits, stated plainly because they affect whether a figure
should be cited:

- Summary of Deposits is an annual snapshot, not real-time deposits.
- ACS figures are rolling 5-year survey estimates, not point-in-time counts.
- Roughly half of active banks have an LEI recorded with the FDIC, which is
  what HMDA filings are matched on. Coverage is high above $1 billion in
  assets and sparse below $100 million. Many small banks also fall under
  HMDA reporting thresholds and do not file at all, so an absent HMDA record
  usually means a small institution rather than missing data.
- State-chartered institutions that are not FDIC-insured are not covered.

## Pages

- [Home and institution search](https://vaultbot.ai/): search any bank or
  credit union by name, acronym or partial match.
- [Industry analytics](https://vaultbot.ai/industry): charter, branch and
  deposit trends over time.
- [Find a lender](https://vaultbot.ai/lenders): composite lending score with
  state and ZIP filtering.
- [New charters](https://vaultbot.ai/charters): de novo banks and credit unions.
- [M&A activity](https://vaultbot.ai/ma): merger and acquisition history.
- [MCP server](https://vaultbot.ai/mcp): connect Vault to an AI agent.
- [MCP setup](https://vaultbot.ai/mcp/setup): connection instructions.

## For AI agents

Vault runs a public Model Context Protocol server at
https://vaultbot.ai/api/mcp — no authentication, no sign-in. It exposes
tools for institution search, bank and credit union profiles, peer and
industry metrics, lender rankings, asset quality, loan mix, brokered
deposits, branch data, county deposit market share, county demographics,
HMDA lending, leadership lookup, new charters and M&A history.

Agents should prefer the MCP server over scraping these pages: it returns
structured JSON with explicit source attribution and coverage caveats.

## About

Vault is built and maintained by iDENTIFY (https://goidentify.com), a data
infrastructure and analytics firm working with community banks, credit
unions and fintechs.
